headline: RapWire 24/7: Wayne, Drake, Diddy, Takeoff, MC Lyte and GTA VI lead the verified slate
body: RapWire's five-slide original editorial carousel covers Lil Wayne and Drake's unreleased music vault, Diddy's revised projected release date, a Takeoff estate witness dispute, MC Lyte's Hall of Fame tour, and new GTA VI safehouse details. Each slide pairs a current verified update with the real artist, court, or game subject and keeps the reporting legible on the artwork and in the caption.

caption:
1) Lil Wayne (@liltunechi) says he and Drake (@champagnepapi) have a “whole bunch” of unreleased collaborations, including music from 2014 and 2015. Wayne says he keeps updating the files and sending new versions to Drake, but no release has been announced.
2) Sean “Diddy” Combs is now listed for a projected release on March 2, 2028, six weeks later than the prior Jan. 21 date. The Bureau of Prisons has not publicly explained the adjustment, and Combs’ spokesperson said the calculation is not disclosed.
3) Quavo and Offset could be called as witnesses in a dispute over a confidential wrongful-death settlement tied to Takeoff. Takeoff’s mother, Titania Davenport, is arguing for Georgia venue against Kenneth Ball, while the filings do not mean either rapper has actually been ordered to testify.
4) MC Lyte (@mclyte) is launching her 12-city Road to the Hall of Fame tour on Oct. 11 in Brooklyn. The shows are framed as roughly 90-minute mixes of performance, storytelling and career history as she celebrates her Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction.
5) Rockstar’s full Rob Nelson interview gives GTA VI a more lived-in open world: safehouses work more like interactive camps, Jason and Lucia keep daily routines and can text, and vehicles store outfits and weapons. The Oct. 7 transcript describes a July preview build ahead of the Nov. 19 launch, so these details are not a final patch list.

@Rapwire247
